scope: Corollary 5.4 of the manuscript “Arithmetic classification and non-Pisot singularity for Bernoulli convolutions” (preprints/Arithmetic-classification-and-non-Pisot-singularity-for-Bernoulli-convolutions-October-3-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 153 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d7c67b840e442230), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let β1 and β2 be the respective real roots greater than one of P1(x) = x4 − x3 − x2 − x + 1, P2(x) = x4 − 2x3 + x2 − 2x + 1. Then β1, β2 ∈ (1, 2) and both ν1/β1 and ν1/β2 are singular.
